label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_01
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Well, if it isn’t my little challenger,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_02
text: What brings you back here, baby? Finally ready\nfor that rap battle?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_select_01
text: I’m here for the Gym inspection!

label: common_2020_ghost_010_select_02
text: Yeah! A rap battle sounds great!

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_03a
text: Hold on. You’re telling me La Primera sent YOU\nto check on my Gym?![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_03b
text: Hah! So you’re a Champion Rank comedian too![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_04
text: So instead of her, I get you...[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_05
text: She sent a rookie Champion instead of comin’\nout here herself?\c\nDoesn’t she know who I am?![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_06
text: Sorry, I got heated there. Don’t worry, though—\nyou aren’t the one who struck that nerve.[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_07
text: Oh well. I was just thinkin’ I’d like to see you\nagain anyway. Guess this is just how fate has it![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_08
text: If we’re doin’ this, let’s do it. Ready to show me\nhow strong all those adventures made you?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_retry
text: You ready to show me how strong you are\nnow, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_09
text: Now THAT’s the spirit! C’mon, let’s put on a\nkiller show![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_10
text: No? Then what’d you come here for? Come back\nwhen you’re ready to go![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

label: common_2020_ghost_010_ghost_nobattle
text: Hey now! You’re gonna need at least two\nPokémon in battlin’ shape to take me on![VAR 0x0114(001B)]
